description: The current state of an order request made with execute_previewed_order: pending_approval, executed, rejected, failed, expired or declined, with fill price and stop order id once executed. Use to follow an order that was waiting for a person's approval. Not for listing orders (use get_my_open_orders). Input: request_id. Next: get_my_open_positions once executed.
name: get_order_request_status

current.description: The order's value for this rule
current.title: Current

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog
deprecation.title: Deprecation

layer.description: mandate (this agent's trading permissions), user (the person's global limits), platform or venue
layer.title: Layer

limit.description: The limit it was checked against
limit.title: Limit

rule.description: Which rule, e.g. max_risk_pct, price_band, size_step
rule.title: Rule

actual.description: The charged amount in asset; negative = a rebate
actual.title: Actual

actual_usd.description: What the exchange charged, USD; null until its fill records show it (or when charged in another asset, see actual and asset)
actual_usd.title: Actual Usd

asset.description: The asset it was charged in (USDT, USDC, BNB …)
asset.title: Asset

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog
deprecation.title: Deprecation

estimated_usd.description: The account's rate x the filled notional, USD
estimated_usd.title: Estimated Usd

status.description: pending (not read yet), done, or unknown (the exchange never showed it)
status.title: Status

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog
deprecation.title: Deprecation

size_base.description: Closes this much when triggered, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD
size_base.title: Size Base

approval_expires_at.description: While pending: when the approval request lapses, ISO 8601 UTC
approval_expires_at.title: Approval Expires At

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog
deprecation.title: Deprecation

error.description: Why it was rejected or failed
error.title: Error

fee.description: Once executed: the trading fee, estimated at once and replaced by the amount the exchange charged once its fill records show it

filled_size.description: Filled size, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD
filled_size.title: Filled Size

legs.description: A ladder entry: per leg {price, size_base, order_id, sl_oid, status}; status resting, or after a refused leg withdrawn, filled or partly_filled
legs.title: Legs

order_id.description: Venue order id of the fill
order_id.title: Order Id

receipt.description: Signed receipt (compact JWS, EdDSA) once executed: request, checks, preview price, fill, slippage, order ids, delegation. Verify with /.well-known/tradehub-receipts.jwks
receipt.title: Receipt

request_id.description: Order request id; get_order_request_status(request_id) follows it
request_id.title: Request Id

sl_oid.description: Venue order id of the protective stop
sl_oid.title: Sl Oid

status.description: pending_approval, armed (a trigger entry waiting for its price), executed, rejected, failed, expired, declined, cancelled, or executing (TradeHub has not confirmed the outcome yet: check get_order_request_status)
status.title: Status

take_profits.description: set_take_profit_levels: the take-profits now on the exchange
take_profits.title: Take Profits

trigger_expires_at.description: status armed: when it lapses unless reached, ISO 8601 UTC
trigger_expires_at.title: Trigger Expires At

trigger_price.description: status armed: opens at market when the mark reaches this, USD per coin
trigger_price.title: Trigger Price
